_about: Comparison groups: a product's £/kg and protein per £ are judged only against its own group. A group = what a shopper would realistically buy INSTEAD (substitutes). Every product is classified into exactly one group (data/groups.json, id → group). `cat` is the app category the group is filed under. Edit here, then reclassify.
